From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation — AcmeHealth (post-demo follow-up)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time to demo with us today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from Redwood:

- Goal: Start the vendor security questionnaire (SIG) and confirm a scope for SOC 2 / HIPAA evaluation so your security team can kick off the review.
- Actions we need from Acme: provide the security contact for us to work with, confirm whether PHI will be in scope, and confirm desired data residency (US/EU).
- From our side: attaching a copy of our SIG template and a one-page SOC 2 summary. We can also pull the relevant audit artifact excerpts once we confirm scope.

Questions to clarify before your security team starts:
1) For SOC 2 — do you need evidence covering redwood-hosted logs and backups, or only application-level controls?
2) Is HIPAA in-scope for this integration (will Acme send PHI to our API)?
3) Any checkbox on acceptable encryption for backups (customer-managed KMS vs. Redwood-managed)?

Proposed timeline: if we get the security contact and scope by EOD Thursday (4/22), we can return the filled SIG answers and evidence links within 3-5 business days.

Attachments: SIG_template.pdf, Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf

Thanks — I've cc'd Marissa (security ops) to help coordinate evidence pulls.

Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>

Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation — AcmeHealth (post-demo follow-up)

Camila — thanks for the clear recap. Priya on our security team (security@acmehealth.com) will be the point of contact for the questionnaire — cc'ed here. Quick answers inline to your clarifying questions:

1) SOC 2: We will need evidence that covers both application-level controls and host/log retention for the production environment (prod-redwood).
2) HIPAA: Yes — Acme will be sending limited PHI to your API (hashed patient IDs and care notes); HIPAA will be in-scope.
3) Backups: We prefer customer-managed KMS where possible, but we can accept Redwood-managed with a documented compensating control for now.

Timeline: Priya, can your team pick this up? Ideally we want completed SIG answers and artifacts within two weeks — will that work for Redwood?

Alex
Director, Integrations | AcmeHealth
alex.johnson@acmehealth.com | (617) 555-0120

Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:20:10 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation — AcmeHealth (post-demo follow-up)

Hi Priya / Alex —

Great — thanks for confirming scope. Short answers and the plan:

- SOC 2 scope: we can include host/log retention and application controls for prod. Marissa (cc) will run the evidence pull and mark which artifacts are applicable to the requested scope.
- HIPAA: Redwood supports HIPAA workloads — we'll confirm the Business Associate Agreement (BAA) process and next steps.
- KMS: We support customer-managed KMS in our Private deployment; for hosted API we can provide documented compensating controls. Please let us know if you need a formal KMS attestation.

A few clarifying questions from our security ops team to help prioritize artifacts:
1) Which APIs/endpoints will be used in production and expected average qps? (helps us target logs and API access evidence)
2) Do you require encrypted field-level storage for PHI, or is transport encryption + tokenization sufficient?
3) Any specific retention period for audit logs (30/90/365 days)?

If you prefer, Marissa can set up a 30-minute call with Priya + Jordan + myself to go over the SIG and map evidence to questions. Our suggested timeline: once we get answers to the three clarifying questions, we'll return a completed SIG with links to artifacts within 5 business days.

Thanks — looping Jordan (solutions engineering) to help with API specifics.

Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
